purpose: Freeze every advisor-replaceable nonlinear start shape without increasing the deterministic solver budget.

slot_id.scope_id: 64 lowercase hex training_scope_id computed exactly by split-policy-v1.json from its canonical membership ledger and scope payload; it is non-circular and contains no row values
slot_id.cell_ordinal: zero-based order of admissible raw-x membership gaps sorted by their left x group; the gap values are not encoded in the slot ID

p2_rule.vector_order: concatenate nonlinear parameters of the left variant, then the right variant; a linear variant contributes no values

validation.known_slots: The application materializes the exact slot ledger for every full-data and outer-training scope before any advisor request or solver call.
validation.default_vector: For each replaceable ordinal, the deterministic schedule vector at that ordinal is retained unless one unique schema-valid suggestion for the exact slot ID passes length, binary64 finiteness and inclusive-bound checks.
validation.duplicates: Any repeated slot_id invalidates the complete response for that scope.
validation.unknown_slots: Any slot_id absent from that scope's frozen ledger invalidates the complete response for that scope.
validation.cardinality: Omitted slots keep defaults; suggestions cannot create slots, starts, structures, cells, directions or families.
validation.atomic_scope_fallback: Malformed JSON, schema failure, duplicate/unknown slot or any invalid vector rejects all suggestions for that scope and restores every deterministic default.
